info.name: Lumina Capital — Transactions Platform
info.description:
All seven endpoints from SPEC §4. Every request carries X-Session-Token: <corporate-email> — the collection sends the value of the `email` variable automatically. Set `baseUrl` and `email` in the collection variables tab (or override per environment).

## Try this order
1. **POST /upload-transactions** with a sample from `samples/` — capture the returned `upload_id`.
2. **GET /uploads** to see the file in history.
3. **GET /clients** to list clients in the active upload.
4. **GET /clients/:client_id/positions** for one client's positions.
5. **GET /violations** (try the type filter).
6. **GET /analytics** for the dashboard payload.
7. **PUT /users/me/last-viewed** to switch the active upload — instant flag flip, no pipeline re-run.

variable.description: Captured automatically by the POST /upload-transactions test script.

request.description: Ingest a .xlsx. Returns 200 with `{upload_id, summary}` on success, 422 with `rejected_rows` on structural failure (missing column, bad action, non-numeric, missing field). Non-positive quantity/price is NOT a structural failure — it returns 200 with an INVALID_VALUE violation. Max 10MB.
List every upload in the shared pool, newest first. `is_last_viewed` is computed per-user against `users.last_viewed_upload_id`.

Switch the active upload for the current user. Instant — no pipeline re-run; the results for that upload were stored at upload time (ADR 014). Returns the same summary shape as POST /upload-transactions. 404 if the upload doesn't exist.
One row per client in the active upload, with transaction/position/violation counts. Empty list if the user hasn't selected an upload yet.
Every position for one client in the active upload: quantity, avg_cost, realized_pnl, unrealized_pnl, last_price. 404 if no active upload is selected or the client doesn't exist in it.

query.description: Optional: filter by a single client

request.description: Violations for the active upload. Both filters are optional and combine with AND.
Dashboard payload for the active upload: top_traded_isins, avg_holding_time_per_client, most_volatile_client, isin_concentration (+ win_rate bonus).
